newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee buyers interested in Jan/March 1997.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee buyers interested in Jan/March 1997.

text.p: Higher coffee futures and steady differentials prompted some roaster buying in the German physical market.
Interest focused on Jan/March dates and up to June.
Traders said arabicas were $5-17 up on the week per 50 kg fob, with Brazils at $115 and Kenyan AB FAQ at $156, while Indonesian robustas were stable at $65 cif, November.
Brazilian sellers offered price concessions for October/November while Colombians were steady and Kenyan and Tanzanian prices rose sharply.
Consumers prefered to buy second-hand material.
